error: The specimen could not be loaded.
webglUnavailable: 3D viewing is unavailable in this browser.
instructions: Drag to rotate. Scroll or pinch to zoom. Select a marker, an anatomical part, or a named anatomy button to learn more. Press Escape in the viewer to close a note.
studyMissing: Field study unavailable: the approved English recording and its complete timing data have not been supplied.
studyData: Field study unavailable: the recording configuration or timing data is invalid.
studyTargets: Field study unavailable: required armor or tail-club targets are missing.
studyReady: Play the narrated introduction. Pause to explore and inspect.
studyPaused: Narration paused. Explore or inspect, then resume.
studyBuffering: Narration is buffering. Progress is held.
studyBlocked: Playback was blocked. Select Play to continue, or Exit.
studyMediaError: Narration could not be loaded or played. Retry reloads the same recording at the retained position and remains paused.
studyTimingError: The recording duration or timing data does not match. Correct the recording configuration before retrying.
